samples.analysis:
A Google Chrome Incognito window is open to a YOLOKFX webpage titled **“How to Get Free SHEIN Products.”**

- A black site header shows the **YOLOKFX** logo and navigation links: **HOME, FASHION, TRENDS, CONTACT**, plus a search icon.
- The main article introduces the official SHEIN reviewer/product-testing program.
- Near the top is a survey-style prompt: **“One last question and we will show you how!”** asking how the user prefers to receive free items, with green buttons labeled **“Store pickup”** and **“Home delivery.”**
- A large **SHEIN** logo and an **“OFFICIAL REVIEWER PROGRAM”** badge appear below.
- Visible article text explains that selected users may receive products to evaluate, that selection is **never guaranteed**, and that participants may test clothing, shoes, accessories, and other products.
- A prominent section heading reads **“🔥 THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP BEFORE APPLYING,”** advising users to keep their SHEIN profile complete and submit applications through the official SHEIN website or mobile app.
- Ads are visible: a top banner saying **“Claim your free ad credits”** with a red **“GET OFFER”** button, and a right-side Capital One Shopping ad saying **“Coupon codes found!”** with an **“Apply Codes”** button.
